title: Chapter 64 — Account Rescue: Failures, Complaints, and The Save
intro: The failure taxonomy, the rescue protocol, and the complaint as gift.

sections.title: Every Failure Is a Test
sections.content:
When something goes wrong with a trade account — a missed delivery, a wrong product, a pricing error — the response determines whether you keep the account or lose it.

Acknowledge the failure immediately. Take responsibility. Fix the problem. Then prevent it from happening again.

A complaint handled well often strengthens the relationship. A complaint ignored always weakens it.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating account rescues, ask:

Does the salesperson respond to failures immediately — or delay?
Do they take responsibility — or deflect?
Is the failure being used to improve the process — or just apologized for?
